title: breathing pause
task: Chest respiration band: breath amplitude over 30 s -> normal / shallow / pause.
signal: 6 breath-amplitude sub-windows of 5 s (4-bit); shallow breathing scales 2-4 consecutive sub-windows to 35-60 %, a pause holds 2-3 consecutive sub-windows near zero (10-15 s); per-window and per-sample noise.
model_size: layers [6, 10, 8, 3], 164 weights (4bit hidden, 5-bit output layer); input 6 lanes x 4-bit unsigned
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
